snippet.title: 1492 - Colonization of the New World
snippet.description:
Steam Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861100/1492__Colonization_of_the_New_World/

Chart your nation’s rise in 1492 Colonization of the New World, a turn-based strategy game where you explore, settle, trade, and lead your colonies to independence amid rival empires and native alliances during the Age of Discovery.
